audience.question: Who is RoleCue for?
audience.answer: RoleCue is for people preparing for technical interviews, whether you’re starting out or moving to a new role.

gettingStarted.question: What do I need to get started?
gettingStarted.answer: Create an account, bring a target job description, and have a microphone ready for the spoken interview.

jobDescription.question: Are the questions based on my job description?
jobDescription.answer: Yes. RoleCue uses the technical context in your job description to guide the interview. Later questions also respond to your answers.

interviewer.question: Can I choose my interviewer?
interviewer.answer: Yes. For your own practice sessions, choose an available system or personal 3D avatar and a voice profile.

afterSession.question: What do I get after a session?
afterSession.answer: You get an interview report with an evaluation of your technical responses, so you can review your attempt and see what to improve.

free.question: Can I start for free?
free.answer: Yes. You can create an account and start practicing for free.
